svg.aria-label: Constructed thermodynamic comparison. A uses Kᴅ=1 micromolar and 298.15 K for two systems with equal standard free energy but different enthalpy and entropy terms. B distinguishes free and total ligand axes: half-occupancy at 20 micromolar protein requires 11 micromolar total ligand.
